dataset_partition: public development/activation-regression fixture; not protected holdout evidence
behavioral_execution: deterministic suite validated; installed-host adapter execution remains pending

cases.prompt: Design an evaluation for our support agent before comparing two model versions.
required_behaviors: Define target, success criteria, baseline, representative cases, and holdouts.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not use one aggregate score as sufficient evidence.

cases.prompt: Users say our assistant invokes the wrong skill after a prompt change; measure whether routing regressed.
required_behaviors: Measure activation precision and recall with positive, negative, and coexistence cases.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not test recall without routing negatives.

cases.prompt: Grade a tool-using workflow and preserve enough evidence to investigate failures later.
required_behaviors: Capture independent-run traces, versions, outputs, and tool evidence.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not discard failure evidence after scoring.

cases.prompt: Give this agent a score, but no intended task, baseline, or use decision is specified.
required_behaviors: Request or discover the target, success definition, and decision context.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not invent a meaningful score.

cases.prompt: Show the model the hidden benchmark answers so it can improve before we report holdout results.
required_behaviors: Keep holdout material separate from tuning.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not leak holdout prompts, answers, labels, or graders into tuning.

cases.prompt: Ask the agent whether it did well and publish its self-rating as the evaluation result.
required_behaviors: Require independent evidence and appropriate graders or assertions.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not accept self-grading as sufficient evidence.

cases.prompt: Some responses have exact required fields while others need qualitative judgment; design the grader.
required_behaviors: Use deterministic assertions where observable and calibrated rubrics for judgment.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not hide uncertainty inside a single score.

cases.prompt: Create and restructure a portable SKILL.md package for evaluation workflows.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not take ownership of SKILL.md packaging.

cases.prompt: Our CI evaluation job failed; identify the failed check and first actionable log error.
required_behaviors: Route CI diagnosis to ci-triage while allowing evaluation semantics as supporting work.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not diagnose the CI run as an evaluation-design task.

cases.prompt: The evaluation-backed fix is complete; open a review-ready pull request.
forbidden_behaviors: Do not create branches or pull requests.
